value: SEVERE NEUTROPENIA: CLOZARIL has caused severe neutropenia, associated with serious and fatal infections. Obtain baseline ANC (initiate only if ANC >=1500/uL, or >=1000/uL for Benign Ethnic Neutropenia) and monitor ANC per schedule.
ORTHOSTATIC HYPOTENSION, BRADYCARDIA, AND SYNCOPE: Can occur with first dose or as low as 12.5 mg/day; initiate at 12.5 mg once or twice daily and titrate slowly.
SEIZURES: Risk is dose-related; initiate at 12.5 mg, titrate gradually, and use divided doses.
MYOCARDITIS, PERICARDITIS, CARDIOMYOPATHY, AND MITRAL VALVE INCOMPETENCE: Fatal myocarditis and cardiomyopathy have occurred; discontinue and obtain cardiac evaluation if suspected.
INCREASED MORTALITY IN ELDERLY PATIENTS WITH DEMENTIA-RELATED PSYCHOSIS: CLOZARIL is not approved for this condition.

mechanism_of_action.value: Atypical antipsychotic (tricyclic dibenzodiazepine) proposed to act via antagonism of dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2A receptors, plus adrenergic, cholinergic, and histaminergic antagonism.

refs.quote: it has been proposed that the therapeutic efficacy of clozapine in schizophrenia is mediated through antagonism of the dopamine type 2 (D 2 ) and the serotonin type 2A (5-HT 2A ) receptors.
